# Heinrich Böll Foundation | Southeast Asia

> The Southeast Asia regional office of the Heinrich Böll Foundation focuses on environmental justice, climate action, and social movements across the region through research, publications, and advocacy.

Based in Bangkok, the Heinrich Böll Foundation's Southeast Asia office conducts research and publishes analyses on critical regional issues including climate change, energy transition, feminist movements, indigenous rights, and political development. The foundation produces comprehensive dossiers, videos, and publications examining environmental governance, sustainable agriculture, and social justice across ASEAN countries.

## Key Topics

- Southeast Asia
- Climate change
- Energy transition
- Environmental justice
- Feminist movements
- Coffee production
- Indigenous communities
- ASEAN
- Human rights
- Sustainable agriculture
- Environmental governance
- Mining and critical minerals
- Social justice
- Climate action
- Regional development

## Research & Analysis Dossiers

- [Climate and Energy in Southeast Asia](https://th.boell.org/en/climate-and-energy-southeast-asia): Dossier on climate, energy transition, and environmental policy in Southeast Asia
- [Brewing Resilience: Coffee and Climate Change in Southeast Asia](https://th.boell.org/en/brewing-resilience-coffee-and-climate-change-southeast-asia): Comprehensive dossier on coffee production, climate change, adaptation strategies
- [Vietnam in Motion](https://th.boell.org/en/vietnam-in-motion): Web-dossier exploring contemporary Vietnam through scholarly, artistic perspectives
- [ASEAN and The Mekong](https://th.boell.org/en/asean-and-mekong): Web-dossier on Mekong region, hydropower, indigenous communities, environmental governance
- [Treasures and Tragedies: Critical Minerals in Southeast Asia](https://th.boell.org/en/treasures-and-tragedies): Analysis of critical minerals extraction, mining impacts, and energy transition
- [Under Pressure: Timor-Leste's Development Path](https://th.boell.org/en/timor-leste-under-pressure): Web-dossier on Timor-Leste's economic, political, and policy development issues
- [Political Development in the Philippines](https://th.boell.org/en/political-development-philippines): Analysis of Philippine politics, elections, human rights, climate, and media

## Publications & Media

- [Publications](https://th.boell.org/en/publications): Publications listing covering ecology, climate change, and social justice topics
- [Videos](https://th.boell.org/en/videos): Video collection on environmental conservation, indigenous knowledge, climate
- [Dossier Format Archive](https://th.boell.org/en/format/dossier): Dossier format archive covering feminist movements, coffee, gender, LGBTQ topics

## Thematic Explorations

- [E-Papers on the Principles of Global Greens](https://th.boell.org/en/e-papers-principles-global-green): E-paper series on Global Greens principles from Southeast Asian perspectives
- [Feminist Movements in Southeast Asia](https://th.boell.org/en/sea-through-feminism-femnimitr): Resource on feminist movements, peacebuilding, and land justice in Southeast Asia
- [Coffee Nation: Indonesia's Relationship with Coffee](https://th.boell.org/en/coffee-nation-indonesia): Photo essay on Indonesian coffee culture, production, and climate impacts
